tex_content.html:
In an ancient solution, the set of spacetime points that are centers of strong $\epsilon $-necks is open.
Proof

\sketch ↗ prop:canonical-neighborhood-stability A strong neck in an ancient flow extends slightly beyond normalized backward time one. Nearby times still have an evolving neck of length greater than one, and a small axial diffeomorphism moves its center to any nearby spatial point. Apply Part (2) of the proposition.

□
